steps.text: 00:38 A.M. \ Dusty
Downtown Lungmen, Plaza, Outdoor Party

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: We followed the directions all the way but why is... is that a block party?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Check out that candle! It's huge!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Settle down, Exusiai.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The air smells so sickly sweet, I feel like I want to puke.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Mmm... we oughta get ourselves a booth here next time. I bet we'd make a bundle!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas, have you heard from the boss?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Not yet. He's probably passed out drunk somewhere.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Exusiai, can you get this thing off my head?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Why!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Thanks to this stupid light on my head, I don't get to wear big fun party hats like that. I'm so jealous!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What happens if you try to force a hat on?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I get a feeling that's something like waking up hungover to find I'm in the passenger seat of a car driven by a very emotionally charged Texas.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: And that don't sound like a good time.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: So you've tried that before...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: So where's the boss?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: There's so many people here, if the enemy chases us this way, they'll get all mixed up with the civilians...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Ah.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: It's Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And you're... the girl from the detective agency...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: And this guy here with you is that infamous knife-wielding helmsman from the docks?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: What? No. That's the craziest version I've heard yet...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I'm just a typical hawker. Oh! Tonight I'm a part-time finball master.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: And you must be Texas?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Something happened tonight. Don't act like you don't know.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Waai Fu, you don't have to be so aggressive with them. They're just...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I know. But it's ridiculous how many times this has happened.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: It's fine as long as you don't get anyone else mixed up in this.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: But when it comes to getting innocent people hurt, causing so much damage to their property, can't you think like honest, law-abiding citizens for once?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Nothin' we can say to that.)

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...So what?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: So we must correct your deficient character.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Th- there's no need to come to blows here. We know we've made a lot of trouble for a lot of people tonight, but we can talk this out.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas?!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Let me say this first: everything that's happened tonight is completely baffling and inexplicable, and also completely exhausting.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: So let's just say I'm not in a great mood right now.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You hear what I'm saying?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: One on one. If I win, you guys follow the rules to the letter.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: ...for at least one month.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Just a month?!)

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And if I win, then you and all your goldbricking busybodies have to mind your own damned business.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Fair's fair... But I won't go easy on you. Get ready!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Ugh. How did we come to this.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Hold on! Both of you, calm down! You can't just have a fistfight in the middle of the...

steps.name: Drunk
steps.text: Woah! Kung fu! Sick!

steps.name: Drunk
steps.text: The wolf's not going down easy. C'mon! Look out behind you!

steps.name: Drunk
steps.text: It's been a long time since I saw Yan kung fu this good! Show us some more!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: This isn't a show!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Get her, Texas!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Watch your leg! It's a feint!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: You don't have to join in!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Soda. Want some?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oh. Thank ya kindly. But ain't ya gonna try to stop this little kerfuffle?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I can't stop it. Looks like you know that already.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: So we just watch?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Or I guess we could cheer them on?

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: *crackle*

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Attention! All good citizens attending the Sauin celebration!

steps.name: Drunk
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Drunk
steps.text: What's up? What's that guy doing?

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Can you hear me?

steps.name: Drunk
steps.text: Hey! You're too loud!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Aight. Great. You can hear me.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Now, everybody, quiet down! Quiet down please!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Lend me your ears. And bow before me.

steps.name: Drunk
steps.text: What's this guy's deal?

steps.name: Drunk
steps.text: Wait a minute, that's Emperor! From Monster Siren Records! C'mon!

steps.name: Drunk
steps.text: Shouldn't he be in Columbia?! What's he doing in Lungmen?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: What is Mr. Emperor... doing?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The boss always does this music producer thing.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I mean, he is a music producer.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Our operating capital ain't just from the logistics business. The baws's got all kinds of revenue streams. Like...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Like what?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Nah. Never mind. Prob'ly best not to say too much.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Grr!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: What's the matter? You're slowing down.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Look how the people are moving around us. It's too regimented. Something's not right.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Don't make excuses!

steps.name: Drunk
steps.text: EM! PER! OR!

steps.name: Drunk
steps.text: EM! PER! OR!
...how noisy.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Today is Sauin, Mr. Emperor, but your dreadful 'music' is loud enough to wake the dead.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Say what?!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You... when did... how'd you get behind me...?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Good night, Mr. Emperor. And a happy Sauin to you.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: ...ugly ass rat, you better... remember...

steps.name: Drunk
steps.text: What just happened? Is this some kind of play...?

steps.name: Drunk
steps.text: Did he just stab Emperor? Is he dead?!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hya!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Hai-ya!

steps.name: Drunk
steps.text: Urk...!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Hey, Waai Fu, you hit the wrong...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No. She didn't.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We're surrounded.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Um... Did they follow us all the way from the slums?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: All these fellers here, they're all on the same team?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: No way. So many...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: They're all here for us. It was a trap. And Mr. Emperor...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: *Gasp!*

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Is this thing on...? Ahem, hello? Testing? People of Lungmen, good evening.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Please do not panic. This dead fellow here is but an insignificant penguin. The Sauin celebrations will proceed as planned. Naturally, some professionals will be here shortly to remove this bothersome corpse.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Now I know this is quite sudden, and I apologize for the interruption, but I thought I would add one more special program to tonight's Carnival.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Our friends from Siracusa have brought us a very special gift. It is hidden somewhere here in this very Carnival.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Time grows short, my friends.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Is he watching me? No, wait, that old man...)

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: It will be terrible if no one finds this precious treasure.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: The very last surprise of your lives.
